pages.title: A Happy Treefarm
pages.text: We all could use a little happiness in our lives. And what makes anyone more happy than seeing a little train, chooing along its tracks and chopping some trees along the way.$(br2)The $(item)Treecutter 3000$() can make all that a reality.

It is made in the $(item)Industrial Assembler$() with materials you are already familiar with, so it should be an easy task for you.$(br2)Once you have made the $(item)Treecutter 3000$(), all you need is a $(item)Cargo Manager$(), $(item)Liquid Manager$(), $(item)Advanced Detector Rail$() and some normal rails.$(br2)The $(item)Treecutter 3000$() will zoop along the tracks, planting saplings and cutting down trees.

All the little train ask in return is that you supply it with ample amounts of $(item)Lava$() and $(item)Water$(). Which you could easily solve with some $(item)Crucibles$() and a $(item)Water Supply Gadget$().$(br2)A $(item)Liquid Manager$() can supply the cart with liquids when the train passes by it, given that the rail next to the manager is an $(item)Advanced Detector Rail$().$(br2)The $(item)Cargo Manager$() can unload wood that the train has harvested.
